correctness.rationale: At fixed first-population spins a_i, the b_i terms separate, so minimization yields -J/n sum_i|M_A-(1+nK/J)a_i|. Rewriting by p=|M_A| gives exactly two piecewise branches: increasing for 0≤p≤t and decreasing for t≤p≤n, forcing global minimizers at p=r_n or p=n. Their energy comparison yields the displayed even/odd Kc and unique a=b balanced versus anti-aligned uniform configurations; no missing intermediate minima. Counting labels and Stirling yield the g_n+2 coexistence and entropy per spin 0 or (log2)/2 in the correct order of limits. An independently written exact rational direct all-spin ground-state enumeration matched both energy and full minimizer count for n=3..7 at 25 rational K choices straddling each threshold, including equality. This is finite corroboration of the all-n algebraic proof.
